subject: Request: Dataflow diagram + KMS custody & privileged access evidence
messages:
From: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@acmeretail.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: security@acmeretail.com
Date: 2026-09-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dataflow and KMS custody evidence request

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Acme security is consolidating supplier evidence for our Q4 vendor review. Can you provide the following by EOD Tuesday (or let us know a firm ETA)?

- Process-level dataflow diagram that shows how PII moves through Redwood’s hosted API, Dedicated, and Private modes (highlight where tokenization/KV caching occurs).
- Inventory of subprocessors with region and role (storage, monitoring, backups, analytics).
- KMS custody diagram: who holds keys (Redwood, customer-managed, cloud KMS), and where keys are stored/rotated.
- A sanitized sample of privileged-access audit logs for the last 30 days (redact user ids if needed).

If you need to chat/whiteboard, happy to schedule a 30-min slot; we just need artifacts for our DPO review.

Appreciate it,
Sarah
Sarah Klein
Head of Security Operations
Acme Retail

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@acmeretail.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-19T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dataflow and KMS custody evidence request

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and clear list. We can provide all of the items you requested. Quick plan and asks:

1) Dataflow diagram: attaching an initial diagram (redwood_dataflow_v1.pdf). This is a consolidated view across Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Please flag any additional boundaries you want visualized.

2) Subprocessor inventory: attaching subprocessor_inventory_20260919.csv. It includes role, primary region, and SOC/Tier where applicable. We will call out any subprocessors that handle backups or logs explicitly.

3) KMS custody: we have a custody map that covers customer-managed keys, cloud KMS, and Redwood-managed envelopes. Monica will attach the KMS diagram and provide rotation/backup notes.

4) Privileged access logs: for privacy we will provide a sanitized export showing access type, role, timestamp, and region — no raw user PII. Hannah will prepare a 30-day extract as a redacted log.

Proposed ETA: initial package by 2026-09-21 EOD PT; if you need earlier, tell us and we’ll prioritize.

Also linking a shared folder for artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-priv-evidence

Best,
Aditya Rao
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-19T11:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dataflow and KMS custody evidence request

Thanks — looping in a few clarifying points before we package: 

- For the dataflow diagram, do we want to include separate swimlanes for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private, or keep them as annotated variants on a single diagram? My recommendation is swimlanes so Acme can see where integrations diverge (esp. prefix/KV cache behavior).

- On privileged-access logs: Acme asked for "sanitized sample". We should provide a single compressed file with: (a) an anonymized event export (columns: event_id, role, action, resource, timestamp, region), (b) a short README explaining redaction rules. I can produce this and attach as privileged-access-runbook-sanitized.log.gz.

- KMS note: We need to explicitly call out the proxy KMS flow used in Private deployments when customers bring their own HSM — they want to see where plaintext keys never touch host memory. Monica, can you confirm the diagram for that?

I'll draft the README and the sampling script used for redaction so the DPO can reproduce.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance

From: monica_patel@redwood.com <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-20T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dataflow and KMS custody evidence request

Agree on swimlanes — attaching a focused KMS custody image (kms_custody_map.png) that shows: customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM), cloud KMS envelope flow for Hosted, and the Private-proxy architecture. Notes:

- Rotation cadence: 90 days (default) for Redwood-managed envelopes; customers can configure rotation for BYOK.
- Backup/Escrow: Redwood does not hold plaintext key backups for BYOK; we maintain encrypted envelopes stored in a geo-redundant vault.
- Subprocessor exception: our logging provider (LogFlow Inc.) has read-only ingest in eu-west-1 for analytics — listed in the CSV. We should flag that explicitly to Acme.

I also pulled a sanitized log excerpt (privileged-access-runbook-sanitized.log) — it's sampled and redacted as Hannah suggested. I will add a short README in the Drive folder explaining the redaction columns.

Monica Patel
Product Security
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@acmeretail.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-21T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dataflow and KMS custody evidence request

Hi Sarah — attaching the package we discussed. Contents included in ZIP and Drive folder:

- redwood_dataflow_v1.pdf (dataflow with Hosted / Dedicated / Private swimlanes)
- subprocessor_inventory_20260919.csv (role, region, SOC status; LogFlow Inc. noted as analytics/log ingest in eu-west-1)
- kms_custody_map.png (visual of BYOK/HSM, cloud KMS envelope flows, rotation notes)
- privileged-access-runbook-sanitized.log (30-day sampled, anonymized event export)
- README-redaction.txt (explanation of fields and redaction rules)

Key callouts:
- For Private deployments with customer HSM, plaintext keys never leave the customer HSM; Redwood operates a proxy that only receives encrypted envelopes.
- Our default retention for access logs is 90 days; we can provide longer retention for enterprise contracts (we can discuss retention via a signed addendum).
- Subprocessor inventory shows a small analytics pipeline in eu-west-1 (LogFlow Inc.) that only receives hashed telemetry — we have attestation from them and SOC reports where applicable.

Next steps: if you'd like, we can set a 30-min walkthrough with Monica and Hannah to answer technical questions and mark any diagram updates. Suggested slots: 2026-09-22 10:00 or 14:00 PT.

Thanks, and happy to move faster if this needs to be in your DPO packet sooner.

Best regards,
Aditya Rao
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
